SYNTHETIC TEST JOB DESCRIPTION — QA Automation Engineer / SDET
Company: Example Sdet Labs (fictional)
Location: Boston / Remote, United States

Responsibilities and selection priorities
Own test automation for web forms and backend APIs. Write Playwright browser tests for authentication, keyboard navigation, validation and screen-reader labels, plus Jest unit tests and integration tests in GitHub Actions CI/CD. Favor entries with concrete test counts and regression prevention. Development experience is useful when it demonstrates test coverage.

Required qualifications
- Playwright
- Jest
- integration tests
- GitHub Actions
- CI/CD
- keyboard

Preferred, not mandatory
- Cypress

Applications are assessed on demonstrated work. Candidates may apply without preferred tools. Do not claim skills you have not used.
